what_this_is: The governed holds standing between the existing modern question-level QI and the canonical longitudinal QI. A hold is finished governance work: a named human read the evidence and recorded that it does not settle the question. It is not backlog and no summary may count it as unadjudicated work.
why_a_hold_is_not_a_fix: Resolving a modern/canonical disagreement changes what a recurrence relationship MEANS. Doing that inside an integration build would be a semantic decision taken by a script. Every disagreement below is therefore recorded and left standing.

conflict_hold_states.HOLD_RECONCILIATION: Modern and canonical layers group the same questions incompatibly and no governed join explains it. Both groupings survive; the adapter reports both and weights neither twice.
conflict_hold_states.RESOLVED_MODERN: A human confirmed the modern grouping. Requires adjudicated_by.
conflict_hold_states.RESOLVED_CANONICAL: A human confirmed the canonical split. Requires adjudicated_by.

topic_mapping_hold_states.HOLD_TOPIC_MAPPING: The family is alive in the 2021-2022 wording-only band and reaches no topic, because the one mapper has never been given that band as input. This is a scope gap in the mapper, not an unmappable family, and it is NOT fixed by classifying the question here -- a second classifier in the adapter would be a second taxonomy by the back door. The route out is to extend build_study_mappings.py input scope to the wording-only band, which is a corpus-scope decision.
topic_mapping_hold_states.MAPPED: The mapper has since reached it; the hold is spent.

conflict_holds.note: The similarity cluster merges the salvage-law ask with the particular-average / general-average ask. They share marine-insurance vocabulary and almost nothing else, and the canonical layer split them into QIF-EM-0009 and QIF-EM-0180. The split reads correct, but confirming it retires a seven-member modern lineage, so a human states it.

Both limbs are UNCLOS. QIF-EM-0053 asks about protection of the marine environment; QIF-EM-0167 asks for the highlights of UNCLOS generally. Sibling asks under one instrument, which is exactly the case where a near-repeat threshold and a semantic adjudication may legitimately differ.

The two canonical families open with the same IMO/ILO-regime sentence and diverge afterwards. A shared framing sentence defeats similarity scoring in both directions, so neither the merge nor the split can be trusted from wording alone.

QIF-EM-0082 is the role of classification societies; QIF-EM-0073 is the purpose of annual surveys and its listed items. QP2310-Q2 is the only member on the QIF-EM-0073 side, so this is a single-member disagreement inside an otherwise agreeing six-member lineage.

Bill of Lading: QIF-EM-0106 asks for its main functions, QIF-EM-0255 asks for a definition and its significance. This is the closest of the seven and the most likely to be resolved as one family, which is precisely why it may not be resolved by a build.

Port State Control split three ways -- provisions, enumeration, and the concept with a stated focus. Three families over four modern members is the widest split observed, and the modern layer saw one lineage. Neither reading is obviously right.

Turbocharging: QIF-EM-0031 lists modern methods, QIF-EM-0111 asks about latest developments. Both carry time-relative language, so the currentness layer already flags them; the family question is separate and stays open.

known_authored_edge_defects.what_this_is: Authored host_recurrence_hint references that name a question which does not exist. They are pre-existing corpus defects surfaced by this integration, NOT integration damage. Each is listed individually so the dangling-edge gate stays sharp for new breakage instead of being switched off.
known_authored_edge_defects.policy: Recording is deliberate. Editing forty paper specs to correct authoring notes is corpus maintenance and is out of scope for a QI -> study integration; mixing the two would make the integration diff unreviewable. Correct these in a bounded corpus pass.

defects.why_broken: QP2404 prints Q1 to Q9. Q78 is a typed run-together of two question numbers, most likely Q7 and Q8.
defects.owner_action: split the reference into the two intended questions, or delete it if the lineage was mis-recalled
